name: @compmd/processor
description: The CompMD processor as WebAssembly: parses, validates and expands a CompMD document in the browser.
author: Hakan Serce

scripts.wasm: cargo build --locked --profile wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p compmd-wasm -p compmd-components-wasm && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir pkg ../../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/wasm/compmd_wasm.wasm && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir pkg/components ../../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/wasm/compmd_components_wasm.wasm && node -e "for (const file of ['pkg/package.json', 'pkg/components/package.json']) require('node:fs').rmSync(file, { force: true })"
